manual-entry.addTradeDescription: Choose an account and enter your buys and sells. Save an entry alone for an open position, or include the exit to record a closed trade.
manual-entry.notesPlaceholder: Your setup, why you took the trade, or what you learned…
manual-entry.notesHint: Markdown supported. Notes are saved with the trade; existing notes are kept when adding to an open position.
manual-entry.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the trade. Try again.
manual-entry.roundTrips: Dates and times use your device’s timezone. Executions matching an open position on {symbol} are stitched into round trips automatically ({count} legs so far).
